column1: # EVENTS-NONE.tsv -- an entry of ipl_gprogs that waits for an event and is NOT graded on a script of its own work, because that work is not the same on two runs of the graphics oracle within the road's law (row icon-graphics-the-waiting-gprogs-do-their-own-work-half-a and -half-b, the cto 2026-11-16): entry, a tab, the measured reason. Such an entry keeps its still picture as its answer.

column2: STAND-IN, ruled by the cto 2026-11-18 (row ipl-gprogs-the-last-four-scripts-ruled): a 1121-line application, Lon's word "You can forget about writing scripts for the huge apps since I will try/test those by hand."; no script and no mask; it counts on its mode 3 pass, its still first picture. MEASURED officer_02 2026-11-16 on icon-master-x through the screen road: report() writes each action's CPU seconds (&time - lastclk) on its status line and on standard output; one script of seven clicked points and I N G T U L Q, run twice, reads 0.00 sec and 0.01 sec for 2-opt and uncross, screen and text alike; no option hides the status line. It keeps its still picture

STAND-IN, ruled by the cto 2026-11-18 on the grader's measurement that day: its pause button toggles, but under the pin a script of press, wait, press reads screen unstable at the wait (unpaused it draws without end), and press and press in one step differ between two runs (the circles drawn between the presses follow the clock); it cannot be paused onto a fixed picture, so its first picture is the test. MEASURED officer_08 2026-11-16 on icon-master-x through the screen road: it calls randomize() and, once its pause button is released, draws without end; the road reads screen unstable on the oracle, an answer no ref carries, so it keeps its still picture (paused at its start)

STAND-IN, ruled by the cto 2026-11-18 on the grader's measurement that day: its first picture is equal twice at 24 bits and at 8 bits (NAME.depth 8 on the graphics oracle), and NewColor is reached only after an image is loaded through its file dialog and mutated; mutable colours at 8 bits are graded by five scripted entries of this package (calib, hsvpick, hvc, drip, colrname) beside the fixture xwin_fn_NewColor, so its first picture is the test. MEASURED officer_08 2026-11-16 on icon-master-x: it recolours an image through mutable colours, and NewColor fails on the road's 24-bit display (fixtures/icon_xwin of harness, xwin_colours answers NewColor failed), so opening any image ends at its notice Cannot get mutable color.; it keeps its still picture

STAND-IN, ruled by the cto 2026-11-18: it reads no event (no Event, WDone or Active; it loops CopyArea and WDelay(10) for ever), so a script has nothing to work, and its first picture is the test. MEASURED officer_01 2026-11-16 on icon-master-x through the screen road: scroller reads no event (its text calls no Event, WDone, WQuit or Active; it loops CopyArea and WDelay(10) for ever and only the road ends it), so no script can do or end its work; its work is the scroll itself, which never holds still on an image that differs across its columns (small.gif, 24x16: screen unstable within a 60 s cap), so it is graded on bands.gif, horizontal bands that scroll onto themselves, its picture still.
